assessment.summary: This study investigates insecticide resistance in Anopheles funestus from Akaka-Remo, Nigeria. It reports high resistance to organochlorines (DDT, dieldrin), pyrethroids, and bendiocarb, with full susceptibility to malathion. Molecular analysis confirms the presence of the L119F-GSTe2 mutation (associated with DDT resistance) and the A296S-RDL mutation (associated with dieldrin resistance). Synergist assays with PBO suggest the involvement of P450s in pyrethroid and dieldrin resistance.
